read_csv_tsv_log: read a CSV or TSV log file and return rolling-averaged x/y data for plotting
plot_log_data: plot a dictionary of log data as multi-panel matplotlib charts with rolling averages
moving_average_smooth: compute a moving average of a numeric array using convolution with a window size
mean_xs_ys_aggregate: aggregate an iterator of x/y pairs by averaging y values that share the same x
str2color_hash: map a string to a hex color from the Tableau20 palette using a hash function
